_comment: Round 3 = round 2 + (a) unlabelled amounts read by the customer's tax-display convention (walk-in 一般 and private K customers: tax-inclusive; company C and agency D accounts: tax-exclusive; G stays open), (b) area/sheet candidates only for sheet-printed products and the per-name tier only for name cards (SCHEMA: kinds = number of people for cards), so that they do not duplicate total_qty in other segments, (c) the four default search variants with a larger deterministic work budget. The engine keeps a term only if more quotes reproduce to the yen.

derived.tax_label: if_(isblank(tax_label), if_(regex(customer_code, '^(一般|K)', 1, '') != '', '税込', if_(regex(customer_code, '^([CD])[0-9]', 1, '') != '', '税抜', '')), tax_label)
derived.a4eq: if_(product == '名刺' or product == '封筒', 0, quantity * kinds * if_(size == 'A3', 2, if_(size == 'B4', 1.5, if_(size == 'B5', 0.75, if_(size == 'A5', 0.5, 1)))))
derived.sheets: if_(product == 'チラシ' or product == 'リーフレット', ceil(quantity / if_(size == 'A3', 4, if_(size == 'A4', 8, if_(size == 'B4', 8, 16)))) * kinds, 0)
